senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. בָּזַר)to scatter, disperse. Part. pass. פָּזוּר; f. פְּזוּרָה; pl. פְּזוּרִים, פְּזוּרִין; פְּזוּרוֹת.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 7:10">Num. R. s. 7</cite>, end <he>וכשהן פ׳ שכינה עמהם</he> and when they (the Israelites) are scattered, the Divine Presence is with them; a. e.—
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 15:22">Ex. R. s. 15</cite> <he>היו פוזרין</he>, read: <he>חוזרין</he>, v. Tanḥ. Ḥayé 3.]

senses.gloss: <cite ref="Q00433">same</cite>. Tosef. Ber. VII (VI), 24 <he>בשעת … פַּזֵּר ובשעת המְפַזְּרִין וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="K00860"><he>כָּנַס</he></cite>.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 10b:4">B. Bath. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>יְפַזֵּר מעותיו לעניים</he> let him scatter his money (give liberally) among the poor.
Pes. 87ᵇ (ref. to צדקת פרזונו, Jud. V, 11) צדקה … שפִּזְּרָן וכ׳ (or שפְּזָרָן Kal) the Lord has done kindness to Israel in scattering it among the nations.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 10a:12">B. Bath. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>רוח מְפַזַּרְתָּן</he> the wind disperses them (the clouds). Midr. Sam. ch. XXV <he>אם מְפַזֵּר הוא דברים</he> whether he would scatter abroad (divulge) the affairs, v. <cite ref="S00460"><he>קוּסְדַּרְיוֹת</he></cite>; a. e.—Part. pass. <he>מְפוּזָּר</he>; f. <he>מְפוּזֶּרֶת</he>; pl. <he>מְפוּזָּרִים</he>, <he>מְפוּזָּרִין</he>; <he>מְפוּזָּרוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 4:3">Neg. IV, 3</cite> <he>במפ׳</he> when the hairs on the leprous spot are wide apart, opp. <he>מכונס</he>, v. <cite ref="K00860"><he>כָּנַס</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Megillah 13b:18">Meg. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>מפ׳ הן בין העמים</he> they are scattered among the nations (of the kingdom), v. <cite ref="Q01572"><he>פָּרַד</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Tevul Yom 2:3">T’bul Yom II, 3</cite> <he>אם היה מפ׳ וכ׳</he> if the garlic was scattered in the mortar; a. fr.

<cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 2:3">Tosef. Sot. II, 3</cite> <he>מנחתה נִפְזֶרֶת אבית וכ׳</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>מִתְפַּזֶּרֶת בבית</he>) her meal-offering is strewn on the ashes; Y. ib. III, 18ᵈ; <cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 17">Sifré Num. 17</cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 16b:8">Sabb. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>ונִתְפַּזְּרוּ וכ׳</he> and the clouds were dispersed and then gathered again.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 36">Gen. R. s. 36</cite>; a. fr.
